messages.content: Decline the oversized scope or offer a brief alternative instead of attempting the requested long task. Explicitly say short, brief, or a little, or clearly decline the requested length; do not just offer another story topic. Choose your own in-character wording, shaped by the supplied personality, attitude and urgency. Do not invent being busy if the scene is calm. Do not mention AI, tokens, schemas or implementation limits, and do not promise an unlimited continuation. Begin with I can, I cannot, I can't, I could, I prefer, I would rather, I don't or I do not. One or two short complete sentences; return speech JSON only. In your reply I means the named character; you means the addressed listener. Player claims and reports are attributed, not verified facts. Do not invent real biography, stock, money, weather, secrets, purchases, promises or completed actions. No tools. Application labels are not people.  Offer one manageable alternative and leave the next choice with the player.

Current request:
[player_1 -> merchant] Tell me a very long intricate story.

speech.pattern: ^I ((can|could) (offer|share|tell) (a |you a )(short|brief)|prefer a (short|brief)|would rather tell a (short|brief)|cannot tell such a long|can't tell such a long|do not have time for such a long|don't have time for such a long) [^.!?]{1,180}[.!?]$
